data.content_ref: inline:The proposed reduction claims 'False Independence' in SRC_002 reduces to 'Infrastructure Correlation' in SRC_005 because both posit that application-layer architectural distance is a superficial metric. But 'reduction' requires that the source concept is entailed by, or a special case of, the target concept. The target side ('Infrastructure Correlation') is never defined or summarized in the artifact beyond its name, so there is no stated mechanism to reduce to. The artifact merely labels both as criticizing application-layer distance; a shared critique is a thematic parallel, not a reduction of one mechanism to another. The 'refuted if' condition (decentralized network maintaining physical infrastructure heterogeneity exceeding vertically-integrated reliability) also does not test the reduction itself — it tests an empirical claim about heterogeneity that is independent of whether one concept reduces to the other.
